items.title: Mose Allison — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: Willie Dixon was a model for you as a songwriter.

ctx.x: I think singer-songwriters performing before... I think you were one of the first in that... Then the folk thing was a completely different kind of music, but kind of coming from the same... I don’t know. I think they appreciated what you did.

But also you were writing original music based on these forms, which Dylan and a lot of these people were trying to do. I think in the interview you did earlier this year in Mississippi, you said that Willie Dixon was a model for you as a songwriter.
